escenas.texto: This week in Africa, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over one hundred and ninety-seven million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Africa edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Africa. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. At number ten, from Tunisia, ZARUFA FF, with a video posted one day ago. Over one point three million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and twenty thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about fifty-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

In position number nine, from Algeria, NarrArty, with a video posted four days ago. Over five point one million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and fifty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-four seconds.
Next up, number eight, BullyJuice, with “Doing natural skincare routine with my daughters..”. Over five point three million views. A Short of just twenty-six seconds. It also has ninety comments.

At number seven, Pastifact, with “The Window Law That Backfired In New York”. Over five point seven million views. And get this: it's a channel with about sixteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-nine seconds.

Coming in at number six, Zack D. Films, with “The Mortician Met His Own Corpse fiction”. Over five point nine million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A Short of just fifty seconds.

Next up, number five, Turner, with “They ruined my 30,000 couch...”. Over six point one million views. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over four thousand comments.

At number four, from Tunisia, War Archives HD, with “How a Soldier Becomes a Sniper”. Over seven point two million views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-nine thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has six hundred and twenty-nine comments.

Bronze medal, from Egypt, Brain Pits, with “This Paper Lets You Cook a Full Meal With Zero Cleanup”. Over eight million views. And get this: it's a channel with about five thousand, seven hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-four seconds.
Silver medal, SunsetCroc, with “Ranking Funniest Waterslide Moments”. Over thirteen million views. A Short of just forty-seven seconds. It also has six hundred and ninety-one comments.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, from South Africa, From The Ground Up, with “How a Snowdrift Becomes An Igloo”. Over twenty million views. And get this: it's a channel with about fifty-five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over one thousand comments.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Next up, number ten, DLT, with a video posted one day ago. Over one thousand comments. A video over fifty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.

Coming in at number nine, from South Africa, From The Ground Up, with “How a Snowdrift Becomes An Igloo”. Over one thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about fifty-five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over twenty million views.

At number eight, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd, with a video posted five days ago. Over one thousand comments. A video over thirty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over nine hundred and forty-nine thousand views.
At number seven, from Morocco, SHAW, with a video posted four days ago. Over two thousand comments. It also has over one million views.

Next up, number six, from Egypt, Brain Pits, with “This Paper Lets You Cook a Full Meal With Zero Cleanup”. Over two thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about five thousand, seven hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-four seconds.

Number four, Ahmed Sabiri Gaming, with a video posted four days ago. Over three thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and fifty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A video over twenty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Bronze medal, Turner, with “They ruined my 30,000 couch...”. Over four thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over six point one million views.

Silver medal, from Egypt, JIGGSo_ar, with a video posted five days ago. Over six thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: eleven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
